target_customer: Busy knowledge workers and individuals (consumer prosumer) who want an assistant they can text to handle tasks, calendars, chats and email
problem: People with overloaded days lose time triaging tasks across calendar, chat and email and want something that handles it from a simple text thread.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer subscription for a personal AI assistant; free public beta, pricing not yet published
product_category: Personal AI assistant over iMessage and RCS text

founders.name: Connor Waslo
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led product for Loom's AI Suite and Monetization team and spent four years at Loom.

founders.name: Rajiv Sancheti
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led design for Loom's AI suite and spent four years at Loom.

technical_complexity.rationale: Messaging channel integration (iMessage and RCS), calendar, email and chat connectors, and a memory layer on top of foundation models. Standard engineering with some hard parts around reliability and agent actions; no model research needed.

defensibility.rationale: Thin application layer on third-party models. Personalization memory could create some lock-in, but several text-based assistants launched in 2026, so copying was easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not known from sources opened. Search results show other text-first assistants (Poke, Pally) publicly launching in 2026, which is after founding.

market_need_then: Rising adoption of AI assistants and chat agents in 2025 and strong demand for lower-friction interfaces. No spend or user numbers for Caddy found; the product was in free public beta.

branding.domain_note: Main site caddy.app with trycaddy.ai and trycaddy.com style domains also in use; purchase history not found.

identity.logo: not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, friendly, conversational with emoji in sample messages (site copy).

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the brand itself found. The name collides with the open-source Caddy web server and several other Caddy products, which weakens search distinctiveness.

outcome_analysis: Caddy is an early-stage active company from the Fall 2025 batch with a five person team and a free public beta. No exit, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding is not publicly confirmed, so its trajectory cannot be judged yet; the main risks are platform dependence on messaging channels and crowding by other text-based assistants that launched in 2026.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: one aggregator lists a 500K pre-seed tied to Y Combinator (likely the standard YC deal, not a round), another lists 3.5M pre-seed from a page naming a different founder. Neither was confirmed by a company or press source, so no round is recorded. A third-party profile (yespress.io) ties the name to the golf caddy role but it is not a founder statement. Pally, a different YC company, raised 5.2M and must not be attributed to Caddy. Competitors such as Poke (public launch March 2026) and Pally (July 2026) post-date founding, so the as-of-founding list is empty. Founder education not listed on the YC page.
